summary: Iteration 13 testing complete. All new Mini App admin panel enhancements verified. Backend: 11/11 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features working - Admin tab with 6 sub-tabs (Stats, Payments, Broadcast, Live, Paid Posts, Users), Go Live button, LIVE NOW badges with pulse animation, Paid Posts CRUD with Deactivate/Activate and Broadcast buttons, Payment History removed from non-admin More menu, darker background with subtle glow gradient.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/miniapp/admin/paid-posts/{telegram_user_id} returns list of paid posts for admin
POST /api/miniapp/admin/paid-post creates new paid post with caption, price, is_active=true
POST /api/miniapp/admin/paid-post/{post_id}/broadcast sends post to all bot users
POST /api/miniapp/admin/live-session/{session_id}/go-live marks session as live and notifies users
Non-admin users (tg_id=9999999) correctly get 403 on admin endpoints
Admin tab only visible for admin users in bottom navigation
More menu for non-admin shows only: Referral, Notifications, Help & FAQ (Payment History removed)
CSS radial-gradient provides subtle glow effect at top
